detail.title: Intex H-110 Micro ATX Gaming Motherboard
detail.overview: The Intex H-110 Motherboard is a compact and reliable Micro ATX motherboard designed for everyday computing, home use, office systems, and entry-level gaming builds. Powered by the Intel H110 chipset and featuring an LGA 1151 socket, it supports compatible Intel Core processors for smooth and dependable performance. With support for dual-channel DDR4 memory up to 32GB, the motherboard provides efficient multitasking and responsive system performance. Its M.2 PCIe 3.0 x4 NVMe/SATA SSD support enables faster storage performance and quick system boot times. Multiple USB, HDMI, VGA, LAN, and audio connectivity options provide convenient compatibility with a wide range of peripherals and displays. The compact 190 × 170 mm Micro ATX form factor makes the Intex H-110 suitable for space-efficient PC builds while offering essential features for a practical and versatile computing setup.
